elements.element: On expiry or termination of the Agreement for any reason, Vendor must provide transition assistance.
elements.evidence: The added provision applies upon expiration or termination “for any reason” and requires MSL, at IBM’s request, to provide the transition assistance described in Section 5.2(a)(ii).

elements.element: Transition assistance must be available for up to six months.
elements.evidence: The clause guarantees only a period of at least 90 days. Because that period could end before six months, six months of availability is not assured.

elements.element: Transition assistance must be provided at Vendor’s then-current rates.
elements.evidence: The clause does not state any rates or other payment terms for transition assistance.

elements.element: On expiry or termination of the Agreement, Vendor must return Customer Data to Customer.
elements.evidence: MSL must “export and deliver to IBM all IBM data in MSL’s possession or control” following any expiration or termination.

elements.element: Vendor must return Customer Data within 30 days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: The added provision expressly requires export and delivery within 30 days after expiration or termination.

elements.element: Customer Data must be returned in a standard machine-readable format.
elements.evidence: Although the clause requires MSL to “export and deliver” the data, it does not require a standard machine-readable format.

elements.element: Vendor must delete Customer Data after returning it.
Vendor must certify its deletion of Customer Data after return.
elements.evidence: No deletion certification requirement is included.

elements.element: On expiry or termination of the Agreement for any reason, Vendor must provide transition assistance.
elements.evidence: The added provision applies upon expiration or termination “for any reason” and obligates MSL to provide transition assistance at IBM’s request.

elements.element: Transition assistance must be available for 90 days.
elements.evidence: MSL must provide the assistance “for a period of at least ninety (90) Days,” which satisfies the 90-day minimum.

elements.element: On expiry or termination of the Agreement, Vendor must export Customer Data to Customer.
elements.evidence: MSL must export and deliver to IBM all IBM data in MSL’s possession or control.

elements.element: The Customer Data export must occur within 30 days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: The provision expressly imposes a 30-day deadline following expiration or termination.

result.reason: The redline achieves the complete fallback by requiring at least 90 days of transition assistance and export and delivery of IBM data within 30 days after any expiration or termination. It does not achieve the preferred position because it does not guarantee six months of assistance, specify then-current rates, require a standard machine-readable format, or require deletion and certification. The addition is targeted and does not disturb the original inventory, product-completion, or transfer provisions. Drafting quality is reduced because “at least ninety (90) Days” has no clear outer limit, “all IBM data” and the export format are undefined, and the timing or duration of IBM’s request right is not fully specified.
